settings.label: Remove cart discount when not eligible for origin (product template)
settings.info: When enabled, clears all cart discount codes if the visitor is not currently eligible (see Product — Discount collection origins + discount percent, or the Eastmans collection page). Prevents a prior Eastmans session discount from applying after browsing elsewhere.

settings.content: Handles and tags that recognize campaign pages. Clearing a field uses the built-in default.

settings.label: Collection handle
settings.info: Visiting this collection turns on the gated cart discount.

settings.label: Collection template suffix
settings.info: Turns on the gated cart discount and loads the carousel script.

settings.label: Promo page template suffix
settings.info: Loads the carousel script. Does not turn on the cart discount by itself.

settings.label: Page template suffix
settings.info: Loads the carousel script on this page template.

settings.label: Collection handle
settings.info: Collections whose handle contains this value use the early-access grid. Hyphens and underscores match.

settings.label: Product tag
settings.info: Products with this tag are treated as early-access offers and stay out of public grids.

settings.label: Position tag prefix
settings.info: Tags like early_access_position_1 set the sort order. Include the trailing underscore.
